text: In the "Say hello" box, run /orchestra-hello right away when the box starts. Do not wait for the user to type it.
why: The box sat for about 16.8 hours (60364s), until the user typed /orchestra-hello in the chat themselves.

text: If a test also fails on the base branch without our change, call it a pre-existing failure and don't let it block the review.
why: The review said 'Blocked · Risk High' only because of 5 failing tests, and those same tests also fail on origin/development/lyra.

text: When a build finishes, clearly list what is still owed (like the app check on localhost:9000) so it is not forgotten before the PR.
why: The Build hand-back said the app check was not run and still owed, and the run went on to review and push anyway.

text: In the "Plan the ticket" box, add this extra text: "show the full plan in the chat before waiting".
why: At the plan gate the user had to ask "Show me the plan?" before they could approve it.

text: When something like a pending template update is found, show a warning but still let the user continue; do not block the action.
why: At the grill step the user said the update should only be shown as available, and they can still create the form without updating.

text: Add a wait for the user after "Make the epic", so the user gets a ping when it needs them and the step time shows the real work.
why: "Make the epic" took 42564s (about 12 hours) but cost only $7.62, which suggests it sat waiting for the user ("ship it.") without a set wait.

text: Every plan must say how the problem will be solved and how many tickets the epic will have.
why: The user had to ask for both after reading the plan: 'You did not said how would you solve the problem in the plan? Also how many ticket will be under this epic?'

text: Before saying a lock or another session is blocking the work, check that it is still held, and explain in plain words what is holding it and why it matters inside a worktree.
why: The user asked 'What do you mean by using?', 'you are working on worktree, right? How other can block?' and 'Is it still holding? The session saying they are not holding anything.'
